full_judgment:
Anwarul Hoque Chowdhury, J:— This appeal at the instance of the plaintiff is directed against the judgment and decree passed by the learned Subordinate Judge, Jessore dated 19.1.68 reversing those passed by the learned Musnsif, Second Court, Jhenidah passed in Title Suit No. 451 of 1967. 

 4. The Court of first instance after a consideration of the pleadings of the parties and evidence on record came to the view that defendant No. 1 who wanted the court to believe in the fact of relinquishment could not prove the same and the plaintiff having purchased the right of defendant No. 2 including the right of reconveyance is entitled to enforce the agreement of reconveyance between defendant No. 1 and defendant N. 2 and in that view of the matter he decreed the suit. On appeal the said was reversed by the learned Subordinate Judge against which this appeal has been preferred before this Court by the plaintiff. 

 15. There is thus substance in this appeal. This appeal is allowed. The judgment and decree of the court of appeal below is set aside and those of the court of first instance restored but in the facts and circumstances of this case there will be no order as to cost before this court.
